# Stop That Shit (STS) for DeepSeek Harness

Arms an explicit, per-session scope contract from a prompt directive and audits
every tool call agai

nst it. Without a directive the guard is inert: every tool
call is allowed and the only thing the mo

del sees is a short advisory that no
contract is confirmed yet.

`lennney/stop-that-s

hit` source

command. Se

## The `/sts` command

`/sts` injects exactly the directive text a user would type, as a normal user
message, so it arms th

rough the same path and cannot widen the contract
silently.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`/sts` needs the harness `commands` service. The bridge acquires it through
`ctx.inject(['commands']

)`, so a harness without that service still loads and
guards normally — only the command is absent.
## State model

`OFF` — no directive seen yet. `OBSERVING` — a directive was seen but no
mutation authority is confi

rmed (`watch`). `ARMED` — a contract with an
effective level.

Each tool call is judged against the contract of the **root** session of the
calling session, so a d

elegated child (root → child → grandchild) is audited
against the root contract. The lineage is walk

ed through the live session store;
if a parent exists but the root cannot be resolved, the call is d

enied with an
explicit "no verified root session" reason rather than guessed at.

A denial is a real tool denial: the model receives the reason text, the event is
recorded, and the h

arness still runs `tools/post-execute` with the synthesized
error result.

## DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 mapping

The vendor adapter was written against an assumed host. `lib/dsh-compat.cjs`
maps the real payloads
without editing `src/`:
| area | host reality | mapping |
| message source | fixed `MessageSourceMap`, no plugin kinds | keeps `source.kind = 'stop-that-shit'
`; the agent loop appends any non-`runtime-context` source verbatim (and would have replaced `runtim

e-context` messages, dropping the text) |
| post-execute lifecycle | `ToolExecutionResult` has no `k
ind` / `completed` / async flag | proven facts only: `ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH` → `cancel`, a pre-exe

cute denial recorded for the same `callId` → `deny`, else no claim (`unknown`) |
| abort code locati

on | `result.error.info.code`, not `result.error.code` | `abortCode()` reads both |
| subagent paren
t | `SubagentRunInfo` / `SubagentRunEndInfo` name the child only | `parentSessionOf()`: child header
`parentSession` → live `agents.get(child).session.header.parentSession` → `agents.currentInitiator(

)` |
| command disposal | `ctx.commands.register()` returns a service-owned disposer | captured and

handed to `ctx.effect()` so unload unregisters the command |
| `/sts` injection | `createUserMessage
` lives in the ESM `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, which local plugins cannot resolve | dynamic `import()` w
hen available, else an identical deep-frozen `{role:'user', source, content, id}` shape |

Synthesizing a `deny` fact for a post-execute result matters: the host runs
`tools/post-execute` eve

n for a call it denied, so an adapter that only reacted
to `ABORTED` would leave a delegation reserv
ation booked forever.
